pages.text: Every machine GUI has tabs on its right edge:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Redstone$(): always run, run with a signal, or run without one.$(li)$(bold)Side Config$(): set each face to Input, Output, By-product or None.$(li)$(bold)Upgrades$(): Speed, Energy, Gas and Liquid upgrades, up to 8 of each.

$(bold)Speed$() makes a machine faster but hungrier. $(bold)Energy$() cuts the power each job takes and grows the buffer. $(bold)Gas$() and $(bold)Liquid$() cut the fluids a machine uses; a machine only takes the ones it can use.
